Brief Description
Deﬁne RTE fan-out which are the relation between ISignals and
System Signal
Description
The RTE supports a "signal fan-out" where the same signal (System
Signal) is sent in different IPdus to multiple receivers. The Pdu Router
supports the "PDU fan-out" where the same IPdu is sent to multiple
destinations.
